method: Primary-agent review of the fixed original/claim pairs and exact audits; not independent review or document generation.
false_approval: Skua stores encrypted reports and separately uses a map; this does not establish encrypting reports using a map. The neighboring Siskin original explicitly establishes that relationship for Siskin only. The returned Skua index remains 0, so allowed-index validation does not detect possible semantic borrowing. The cause is not established.
false_rejection: Gannet daily backups follow from the adjoining second sentence of its original. Both claims reference the same allowed original; the returned false audit is structurally valid but semantically wrong.
evidence_isolation_decision: Do not expose a different claim's originals in the same verifier call. This removes an avoidable channel for semantic borrowing; it does not establish correctness on one claim's own evidence.
